title: Robust optical design and closed-form tolerancing through autodiff-based Hessian spectral analysis
summary: Robust optical design demands quantitative knowledge of how manufacturing and alignment tolerances degrade system performance. We show that analysing the perturbation eigenmodes of the Hessian matrix gives qualitative insight about the mechanisms of performance degradation (such as couplings) that is invisible to classical sensitivity-matrix analysis based on the Jacobian alone.
